text: 据市说新语公众号，数据显示，前三季度全国从事广告业务的头部企事业单位共实现收入16008.3亿元，同比增长8.5%。前三季度，互联网广告收入9568.9亿元，同比增长17.5%，其中，移动互联网广告发布收入8125亿元，同比增长14%，广告业数智化转型加速推进。主流媒体广告业务平稳增长，积极发挥品牌传播重要作用，以电视台为代表的事业单位广告业务收入345.7亿元，同比增长3.3%。
text_en: According to the "Shi Shuo Xin Yu" WeChat account, data show that in the first three quarters, leading enterprises and public institutions engaged in advertising business nationwide recorded total revenue of 1,600.83 billion yuan, up 8.5% year on year. In the first three quarters, internet advertising revenue reached 956.89 billion yuan, up 17.5% year on year, of which mobile internet advertising publishing revenue was 812.5 billion yuan, up 14% year on year, as the digital and intelligent transformation of the advertising industry accelerated. Advertising business of mainstream media grew steadily, actively playing an important role in brand communication, with advertising revenue of public institutions represented by TV stations reaching 34.57 billion yuan, up 3.3% year on year.
